text:
Kai: Heads-up — vendor just flagged that one of the baremetal racks for staging (rack-sg-07) might be ready earlier than their initial ETA. Can we hold one slot for the canary pool? Ticket #PROC-934. Need ETA + confirmation on power/cabling checks.

VendorBot: [vendor portal] rack-sg-07: 6 blades received. Initial QA started. ETA 36-48h. Will post serials once QA passes: https://vendor-portal.example.com/racks/rack-sg-07

Maria: I have a Terraform PR ready to add the pool and the node labels. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/517 - if we can lock a slot we can run smoke tests Wed night. cc @Ashwin

Ashwin: Do we need to bump tenant quotas for the canary? Also — does rack-sg-07 have dual power feeds? last time we saw a single-PDU failover gap.

VendorOps: We can offer a soft reservation for 1 blade for 48h. Power: dual-PDU, redundant. Consolidated ETA looks like 30-40h unless a firmware hold appears. Will post serials + VLAN tag when QA passes. Please provide the procurement ticket number for our records (PROC-934 ok).

DeployBot: Canary deploy pipeline blocked until PR merge + smoke test pass. Noted. I've created a follow-up job that will trigger post-merge.

Kai: Thanks — Maria, want me to merge the PR once serials arrive and VLAN is confirmed? I'll also update the procurement spreadsheet. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1exampleprocurement

Maria: Yes please merge after serials + VLAN confirmation. Smoke test checklist: add these steps to the PR description. Quick smoke command: 
```
kubectl -n staging run smoke --image=busybox --rm -it -- /bin/sh -c "wget -qO- http://staging-canary.healthz || exit 1"
```
And run the perf sanity with the small load generator for 5m.

VendorOps: Serial numbers posted: SN:SG7-0012, SN:SG7-0013. Holding SN:SG7-0012 for you. Reservation expires 2026-03-22T09:00Z (48h). Note: one other blade in the rack flagged for BIOS update but not the held one. VLAN tag for staging-canary: 4207.

Ashwin: Great — tagging oncall: @Oncall-eng can you take the 22:00 UTC slot for the smoke/perf run if everything is green?

Oncall-eng: I can do 22:00 UTC. Please add me as an approver on the PR and drop the final serial/VLAN in the PR comment.

Kai: :thumbsup: I'll update the procurement sheet, add the PR link, and merge after Oncall-eng + VendorOps confirmations. Thanks team!
